title: Two-zone mode "auto" is always on: finish-now and questionnaire entries are planned as two-zone houses
claim: An entry created by Finish setup now (no zone value saved) or by the building questionnaire (never asked the two-zone question) runs the two-zone model, because ThermalParameters.from_config treats the default mode 'auto' exactly like 'on'.
mechanism: thermal_model.py:1122 tests `two_zone_mode in (TWO_ZONE_MODE_ON, DEFAULT_TWO_ZONE_MODE)`; DEFAULT_TWO_ZONE_MODE is 'auto', so the presence rule in the else branch (the documented meaning of auto: 'two-zone as soon as any zone value has ever been saved', and the comment two lines above) is unreachable. config_flow._derive_preset then reads that verdict through presets.preset_from_config and writes two-zone keys for every questionnaire answer, contrary to its own docstring ('derives a single-zone model').

evidence.unit: entries (finish_now entry with no zone value planned two-zone)
evidence.machine: box B13, Linux x86_64 container, 4 vCPU, shared with up to two other finder seats
evidence.contention_note: other finder seats running on the box; the number is a count/plan value, immune to load

perturbation.change: ThermalParameters.from_config wrapped so mode 'auto' (or absent) answers by zone-key presence -- the one-line fix of dropping DEFAULT_TWO_ZONE_MODE from the tuple at thermal_model.py:1122 (`two_zone_auto.py --perturb`)

metric_definition: Created entries whose published two_zone_enabled is True while the entry holds no zone value and never answered the two-zone question (mode absent = auto).
phenomenon_property: An entry whose two-zone mode is 'auto' (or absent) is planned two-zone exactly when it carries a zone value; a setup path that never asks the question yields a single-zone model.
seam_rule: grep -n "DEFAULT_TWO_ZONE_MODE\|TWO_ZONE_MODE_AUTO" custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py  (every reader of the auto default; plus PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D17/s2/two_zone_auto.py over the create_entry paths)

null_control.note: an explicit on/off answer is honoured in both arms; only the auto default is wrong

reproduction_steps: Walk user -> user_sensors -> finish_setup -> finish_now -> setup_overview -> create_entry
Build HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator on the entry; run one cycle
two_zone_enabled is True and the plan carries upper/lower trajectories although no zone value exists
proposed_fix_scope: thermal_model.py ThermalParameters.from_config: let 'auto' fall to the presence rule; re-check presets.preset_from_config / config_flow._derive_preset so a fresh questionnaire derives single-zone keys only; golden fixtures of default entries will drift.
expected_golden_drift: tests/golden coordinator fixtures built from entries without two_zone_mode (coord_minimal and similar)
